description: Security Hub has the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark v3.0.0, the determination's benchmark, and AWS Foundational Security Best Practices subscribed and ready

matrix_rows.gap: Security Hub's standards; Config, GuardDuty and Inspector are judged by their own checks. AWS only: GCP has no Security Command Center without an organization, so its posture is the collector's GCP checks rather than an ingested service.
